cohort: A 35-year-old woman with a heterotopic interstitial pregnancy after IVF and embryo transfer.
finding: Laparoscopic excision and curettage successfully managed a heterotopic interstitial pregnancy, leading to a subsequent term delivery of a healthy baby.
mod_finding: The healthy baby was delivered at term by cesarean section.
gest_age: 7-week gestational age (at referral), 8.4-gestational age (at surgery), term (at delivery)
